key_terms.الْحَمْدَ: Sūrat al-Fātiḥah, the opening chapter recited in prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ: the two rakʿahs associated with the Fajr prayer
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ, prescribed here for the second rakʿah
key_terms.قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ: Sūrat al-Kāfirūn, prescribed here for the first rakʿah

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the two rakʿahs of Fajr prayer according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on the recommended two rakʿahs of Fajr and the surahs to recite in each rakʿah. It indicates flexibility in performing them before Fajr or around its onset, while specifying al-Kafirun in the first rakʿah and al-Ikhlas in the second.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1419 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Pray the two rak'ahs of Fajr (supererogatory prayer) before Fajr, at its time, or shortly thereafter.
In the first rak'ah, recite Surah Al-Fatiha and
In the second rak'ah, recite Al-Hamd and
